state.message: Hi, I ordered the TrailRunner 5 shoes (order #48213) two weeks ago. They arrived yesterday in a size 10 instead of the 9 I ordered, and the box was crushed. I also see two charges of $129.99 on my card for this order. I need the right size before my race on Saturday. Please fix this today or I will cancel my membership.
